Kennel cleaning, a friendly update this afternoon
We write to travelers

Pet Care Notice

Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is taking extra care with kennel cleaning, carrier checks, and handoffs so pets move through Aurelia Skyways with comfort and calm.

Please keep your pet's documents close and allow our team to guide each step. <<FACT F021>> We ask travelers to follow staff directions and keep a gentle pace near the pet lounge.

Our ground team is also watching capacity closely so every pet can be received safely. <<FACT F008>> If you are connecting through Port Isolde, please use the relief area with care and follow posted access details. <<FACT F015>> These steps help protect pets, reduce stress, and keep travel smooth for all.

For help, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
